programs.title: Esperando a Dalí
programs.desc: Barcelona, ​​1974, a period of intense opposition to Franco's dictatorship.Brothers Fernando (Ivan Massagué), a chef, and Alberto (Pol López), an activist, must hide from the authorities.They find shelter in Cadaqués, a picturesque seaside village that is also the home of the famous artist Salvador Dalí (Gal Soler).In this setting, the brothers meet Lola (Clara Ponsot), who helps them find work.Fernando, influenced by Dalí's works and his infatuation with women, finds a passion for creating unique dishes.The man's ambitions grow, especially when Jules (José Garcia), Lola's eccentric father, dreams of organizing a dinner for Dalí himself.Despite the difficulties, Fernando creates a culinary masterpiece that inspires a revolution in the world of taste, which leads to the creation of the famous Surreal restaurant.

programs.title: No Hit Wonder
programs.desc: After a failed suicide attempt, forgotten singer Daniel Nowak (Florian David Fitz) is sent to a closed psychiatric ward where the most serious cases are kept.He recalls the hit from years ago that brought him fame, reflects on his mistakes and thinks with regret about his current life, in which he earns money by performing in supermarkets.Doctor Lissi Waldstett (Nora Tschirner) engages a grief-stricken artist in a pioneering program in which the therapy of people with depression is based on music.Together they form a chorus of patients.They are joined by, among others:shy Elaha (Jerusha Wahlen) and retiree Helmut (Udo Samel).Their common trials bring them closer together, and Daniel has a chance to look at his life differently.

programs.title: And Just Like That...
programs.desc: Carrie Bradshaw (Sarah Jessica Parker) does not lose hope of finding the love of her life.She can count on the support of her friends.Continuation of "Sex and the City".

programs.title: Alita: Battle Angel
programs.desc: Alita (Rosa Salazar), a cyborg girl, wakes up from a coma.It turns out that he doesn't remember who he is or where he is.Doctor Ido (Christoph Waltz) subjected her to a series of tests that revealed that she was a young woman with a unique story.Wanting to protect her, he does not reveal the truth about her past.Alita must adapt to the conditions and rules of life in Scrap City.After some time, he regains his memory thanks to the help of his friend, Hugo (Keean Johnson).Then he realizes that he has incredible fighting skills.She must use them against the power that tries to control her.The film's director is Robert Rodriguez, known from "From Dusk Till Dawn" and "Machete".The script was written by the winner of three Oscars, James Cameron, who considered making "Alita" back in the 1990s. The film was based on the manga.

programs.title: The Greatest Showman
programs.desc: P. T. Barnum (Ellis Rubin) is the son of a tailor who works for the Hallett family.The boy falls in love with his employers' daughter, Charity (Skylar Dunn).They stay in touch for many years, and when they are adults, they get married.One day, Phineas (Hugh Jackman) loses his job.Wanting to ensure the happiness of his wife (Michelle Williams) and two daughters, a man opens a wax museum.When the idea turns out to be unsuccessful, he decides to show visitors live exhibits.He employs outstanding people - including: the acrobat Anne (Zendaya) and her brother W. D. (Yahya Abdul-Mateen II), the woman with the beard Lettie Lutz (Keala Settle) and Charles Stratton (Sam Humphrey).The show attracts a large audience but receives negative reviews;Barnum's museum is called a circus.To improve his reputation, the man invites Phillip Carlyle (Zac Efron) to cooperate with him.He soon meets Swedish singer Jenny Lind (Rebecca Ferguson).The artist's performance turns out to be a breakthrough for his career.

programs.title: A Big Bold Beautiful Journey
programs.desc: Sarah (Margot Robbie) and David (Colin Farrell) meet at a friend's wedding.They go on an expedition during which they relive the most important moments from their past.

programs.title: A Real Pain
programs.desc: American David Kaplan (Jesse Eisenberg) and his cousin Benji (Kieran Culkin) set off on an expedition to Poland.They want to honor the memory of their beloved grandmother Dora.They begin their tour of her home country by joining the team of British guide James (Will Sharpe).Members of the group with Jewish roots visit places related to the history and culture of their ancestors.During the journey, tensions grow between the young men resulting from their different approaches to life.The director and screenwriter of the comedy-drama is Jesse Eisenberg, who also starred in the main role.He called his film "a love letter to Poland".His acting duo, Kieran Culkin, was awarded a Golden Globe.The photos were shot, among others, in Warsaw and Lublin.

programs.title: Lovecraft Country
programs.desc: 1950s.Young black Atticus Freeman (Jonathan Majors), together with his uncle George (Courtney B. Vance) and friend Letitia Dandridge (Jurnee Smollett-Bell), sets off in search of his father (Michael Kenneth Williams).The man is missing and the three of them decide to find out what happened to him.Their journey leads through a prejudiced, racist America.Soon they will face forces that are out of this world, monsters that they had no idea existed.The series is based on the novel of the same title by Matt Ruff.

programs.title: Victor Frankenstein
programs.desc: Scientist Victor (James McAvoy) and his protégé Igor research immortality together.Over time, the consequences of their experiments become more and more terrifying.

programs.title: The Lighthouse
programs.desc: 1890s.A remote island off the coast of Maine.The lighthouse is guarded by two men.Thomas Wake (Willem Dafoe) is old, stubborn and struggling with a painful leg injury.The younger of them, Thomas Howard (Robert Pattinson), initially seems a bit more open due to his age.However, he hides a secret that made him choose to work in isolation.What they have in common is that they are twisted by life.They will have to spend four arduous weeks in each other's company.Over time, isolation from the world and weather conditions take their toll on them.Both lighthouse keepers are slowly losing their sanity.The director of this psychological horror film, which has received many awards and nominations, is Robert Eggers, the creator of the acclaimed film "The Witch: A New England Folk Tale".Jarin Blashke received Oscar and BAFTA nominations for best cinematography.

programs.title: Bring Her Back
programs.desc: After their father's death, the siblings, Andy and Piper, are placed in Laura's care.The boy begins to suspect that the woman is hiding some secrets.It soon comes to light that their guardian is planning a dark ritual.
